name: alloy_dev
label: Alloy ITSM
description: This connector is designed to manage and automate ticket-based operations. It streamlines the creation, updating, and tracking of tickets, helping improve workflow efficiency and service management.

operations.title: Get Current User Profile
operations.description: Retrieve information about the currently logged in user/technician from Alloy Navigator Express

operations.title: Get Objects
operations.description: Retrieve information about Alloy Navigator objects of the specified object class with filtering, sorting, and pagination support

parameters.title: Object Class
parameters.name: object_class
parameters.tooltip: The object class name (e.g., Incidents, Computers, Consumables)

parameters.title: Fields
parameters.name: par_fields
parameters.tooltip: Comma-separated list of field names to include in the result (e.g., ID,Product_Name,Manufacturer)

parameters.title: Sort Ascending
parameters.name: par_sort_asc
parameters.tooltip: Fields by which to sort in ascending order (comma-separated)

parameters.title: Sort Descending
parameters.name: par_sort_desc
parameters.tooltip: Fields by which to sort in descending order (comma-separated)

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.name: par_limit
parameters.tooltip: Number of records to return for pagination

parameters.title: Offset
parameters.name: par_offset
parameters.tooltip: Number of records to skip for pagination

parameters.title: Search Text
parameters.name: par_search_text
parameters.tooltip: Search string for partial text or keyword search

parameters.title: Filters (JSON)
parameters.name: filters
parameters.tooltip: Additional filtering criteria as JSON object (e.g., {"Priority":"High","Status":"Open"})

operations.title: Get Objects Advanced Search
operations.description: Retrieve Alloy Navigator objects using POST method with advanced filtering operators (=, <>, >, >=, <, <=). Supports complex queries without URL length limitations.

parameters.title: Filters (JSON Array)
parameters.name: filters
parameters.tooltip: JSON array of filter objects with name, value, and operation (e.g., [{"name":"Original_Cost","value":"100","operation":">"}])

parameters.title: Sort (JSON Array)
parameters.name: sort
parameters.tooltip: JSON array of sort objects with property and direction (e.g., [{"property":"OID","direction":"asc"}])

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: Number of records to return for pagination

parameters.name: offset
parameters.tooltip: Number of records to skip for pagination
